```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load necessary libraries
library(kableExtra)
source(here::here("R_helpers/generic.R"))
cov_df <- read_csv(file.path(out_dir, "covariates", "final",  "ua_covariates_oblast.csv")) %>%
  mutate(scale_label = paste0(sum_stat, ", ", time_std, ", ", space_std))
cov_processing <- read_csv(file.path(out_dir, "covariates", "final",  "ua_covariates_oblast_description.csv")) %>%
  mutate(scale_label = paste0(sum_stat, ", ", time_std, ", ", space_std))
cov_desc <- read_csv(file.path(out_dir, "covariates",  "ua_covariates_list.csv")) 
master_index <- read_csv(file.path(out_dir, paste0(tolower(country), "_master_index.csv")))|>
  distinct(i_key, i_name, i, ADM1_PCODE, macroregion)
cov_df <- cov_df |> 
  left_join(master_index)
```
# List of covariates
```{r}
cov_desc|> 
  kbl(escape=F, format = "html") |> 
  kable_classic(full_width = F)%>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%")
```
# Processing method
```{r}
cov_processing |> distinct(scale_label,sum_stat, time_std, space_std) |> 
            rename(
              "Std. method label<br>(sum_std, time_std, spatial_std)" = "scale_label",
              "Summary statistic" = "sum_stat",
              "Time window <br> for centering" = "time_std",
              "Spatial window<br>for centering" = "space_std"

            ) |> 
  kbl(escape=F, format = "html") |> 
  kable_classic(full_width = F)
  
```
# Covariate visualisation

```{r}
#| output: asis

for(cov in sort(unique(cov_df$covariate), decreasing = T)){
  cat(paste0("\n\n## ", cov, "\n\n"))
  
  for(m in unique(master_index$macroregion)){
    # m= 'East'
    g <- ggplot(cov_df |> filter(covariate==cov&macroregion==m) , aes(x = t, y = value_std, color = scale_label)) +
      geom_line() +
      facet_wrap(~i_name, scales = "free_y") +
      labs(
        title = paste(cov, '-' ,m ),
        x = "Time",
        y = "Standardised value",
        color = "(Sum_stat, Time, Spatial)"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    print(g)
  }
}
```
